attributes.action: The right to prostate cancer tests needs to be reinstated for men
attributes.background: The right for testing of prostate Cancer in men over 50 has been removed. Thousands more men die of prostate cancer than women from cervical cancer every year and yet that right is not removed. This is a betrayal to UK men, your fathers, grandfathers who have put there best years into this country

rejection.details:
We have a petition that has just opened on this subject which you may wish to sign:

Guarantee PSA tests for all men over 50 to help reduce prostate cancer deaths
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/779895
